explanation: OEIS A325046 (G.f. Σ_{n≥0} x^n (1 + x^n)^n/(1 − x^(n+1))^(n+1)): 'Odd terms occur only at positions n*(n+1) for n >= 0' (proved by S. Fried). The formal a is the same coefficient extraction without signs (Σ C(n,k) C(n+j,j) over n(k+1) + (n+1)j = N), and the statement 'a(N) odd ⇒ N = k(k+1)' matches. Faithful.
